title: *MGT510 GDB ANSWER*
text:
*MGT510 GDB ANSWER*

Answer:

The meeting leader used the Redirecting and Refocusing Discussion Skill.

Reason: When a participant started discussing personal experiences about friendships and office parties, the discussion moved away from the main topic of customer satisfaction. The meeting leader politely acknowledged the participant's comment and guided the discussion back to the original subject.

This skill helps keep discussions focused, saves time, prevents irrelevant conversations, and ensures that the meeting achieves its main objectives.
